title: Bus Stop Description Changes - July 2026
body: A few Bus Stop Descriptions (Names) have been updated in July 2026. Do head over to Settings and re-fetch your bus stop data to get the most up to date information.

title: Service Adjustments - DTL
body: Early Closures & Late Openings (ECLO) along the entire Downtown Line (DTL), between Bukit Panjang and Expo, will take place across nine consecutive Fridays & Saturdays between 10 July 2026 and 4 September 2026.

title: Service Adjustments - SKLRT
body: The West Inner Loop of the Sengkang LRT Line will be closed from 19 April 2026 to 18 October 2026. This is to facilitate the track works needed to integrate the existing LRT line with the expanded Sengkang LRT Depot.

title: Fare Review Exercise
body: PTC grants overall fare adjustment of 5.0% - below the maximum allowable quantum of 14.4%; deferment of remaining quantum (9.4%) supported by additional Government subsidies...
